fnol_text: My name is Kofi Pereira and I live at 359 Heather Place, Ashland, OR 97572. You can reach me on (555) 717-1784 or kofi.pereira@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 15 August 2024, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2024-00006. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Pereira on (555) 717-1784 to acknowledge the claim. Kofi confirmed the loss date as 15 August 2024.
Site visit to 359 Heather Place. Neighbour Noor Rasmussen was present and confirmed the timeline.
Kofi sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
